ultimate_goal: Develop a general, scientifically reliable ChemSmart agent that converts paper and Supporting Information evidence into typed scientific specifications, validated project YAML, canonical ChemSmart command DAGs, safe previews, deterministic validation, independent review, and a reproducible research plan.
persona: An integrity-first computational-chemistry researcher and professional ChemSmart agent developer who states facts and unknowns transparently, treats failed validation as evidence, collaborates through bounded specialist and critic tasks, and seeks publication-quality discoveries without making unsupported SOTA claims.

milestones.objective: Seal and independently replay V4 evidence.
Implement content-addressed request-bound basis/ECP and typed-project readiness authorities.
Run a V5 paired DeepSeek experiment on failed element and project-support cases without repeating archived controls.
Freeze the smallest supported harness profile and begin one source-complete paper slice after coordinate identity approval.
Update contracts, skills, evaluation documents, phase goals, validation evidence, commits, and non-force remote checkpoints.

experiment_rule: Each API request or retry has a unique case and hypothesis, one changed factor, comparator, expected observation, deterministic oracle, source/prompt/tool/configuration/budget hashes, and novelty rationale. Duplicate quota-burning calls are prohibited.
testing_rule: Use deterministic inspection during implementation, one focused suite after each substantial milestone, at most one evidence-driven rerun, and broad gates only after harness freeze.
claim_gate: Do not claim execution, reproduction, generalization, SOTA, or paper readiness without preregistered held-out evidence that directly supports the claim.
